text:
sarah-support: Heads-up — we just received an EUR credit for €42,000 that looks like a customer payment but there's no remittance note or PO. Bank note shows payer string 'ACME LTD PAYREF PAYREFX12345' and beneficiary id 'ACME-EU' which doesn't match our payee mapping. Can payments/accounting take a look?

bank-bot: Incoming payment alert: /payments/trace/1852345678 -> MT103 available? ordering_name=ACME HOLDINGS, ordering_ref=PAYREFX12345, remittance_info=(empty) :eyes:

mike-payments: Can you paste the raw SWIFT/MT snippet the bank provided? sometimes memo gets dropped into structured fields. Also need receiving bank BIC to trace.

sarah-support: Raw snippet from bank support (reformatted):
```
:20:TRN000000
:32A:260316EUR42000,
:50A:/DE987654321
ACME HOLDINGS
:59:/DE1234567890
RECEIVING CORP
:70:
```
Note the :70: (Remittance) field is empty. Bank appended 'PAYREFX12345' to ordering ref but nothing in remittance.

carla-accounting: If :70: is empty we need MT103/MT202 or the client's payment confirmation. I'll do an amount+date search in PaymentOps — sometimes we can match via ordering account.

carla-accounting: Quick search: there is an open AR for INV-9987 for €42,000 that matches date range. Not auto-allocated. Recommend we ask for MT103 and tentatively hold allocation.

ben-ops: I can open a correspondent request to our bank for the full MT103 copy. ETA 24-72h. Meanwhile, set invoice to 'Investigation — hold auto-reconcile'.

sarah-support: Client responded with a screenshot from their online bank showing payment initiated 2026-03-15 and reference PAYREFX12345 but no MT103 attached. They say beneficiary is 'Redwood Inference GmbH' but our ledger uses 'Redwood Inference Ltd'.

mike-payments: Ask client to request MT103 from their bank and to provide the Transaction Reference Number (TRN) and ordering account number. That will speed reconciliation. Also ask for the beneficiary IBAN ending digits to verify.

carla-accounting: Also flag potential VAT/legal entity mismatch: if payer paid the parent entity, tax treatment might differ. But priority is matching the payment. If we get MT103 with TRN we can post allocation.

andrew-finance: :thumbsup: proceed with bank trace. If client provides bank statement + internal approval we can provisionally allocate pending MT103. Keep me updated.

bank-bot: Update from correspondent: MT103 received. Transaction Reference: TRN987654321. Ordering Name: ACME EU HOLDINGS. Ordering Account: DE987654321. Remittance field blank. Beneficiary IBAN ends ...4321. Attachment: /files/mt103-TRN987654321.pdf :white_check_mark:

carla-accounting: Matched TRN987654321 to incoming booking by amount and IBAN suffix -> allocating to INV-9987 now. Will record note that remittance was blank and allocation used TRN + client statement. Checking VAT impact separately.

sarah-support: Allocation posted and invoice updated. Client and ops notified. Marking thread resolved for reconciliation purposes — will reopen if VAT/legal requires more review. :tada:
